question: In July 2017, among all visitors who bought any YouTube-related product, which distinct product—excluding those containing ‘YouTube’ in the product name—had the highest total quantity purchased?
sql:
-- Final query: Find the distinct product with highest total quantity purchased by visitors who also bought YouTube products
WITH youtube_buyers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT t.fullVisitorId
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_201707*` AS t,
  UNNEST(t.hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE LOWER(p.v2ProductName) LIKE '%youtube%'
    AND h.eCommerceAction.action_type = '6'
),
visitor_products AS (
  SELECT t.fullVisitorId, p.v2ProductName, SUM(p.productQuantity) AS total_quantity
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_201707*` AS t,
  UNNEST(t.hits) AS h,
  UNNEST(h.product) AS p
  WHERE t.fullVisitorId IN (SELECT fullVisitorId FROM youtube_buyers)
    AND LOWER(p.v2ProductName) NOT LIKE '%youtube%'
    AND p.productQuantity IS NOT NULL
    AND p.productQuantity > 0
  GROUP BY t.fullVisitorId, p.v2ProductName
)
SELECT v2ProductName, total_quantity
FROM visitor_products
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1
